capabilities.capability: the single deterministic lifecycle every capability follows
capabilities.evidence: UCIC-001 declares fifteen mandatory stages for taking a capability from selection to production readiness, and is the canonical owner. What it does not do is make the stage graph DISCOVERABLE or EXECUTABLE as a graph: the stages are prose in a table, nothing measures whether each stage's obligations resolve, and the universal engineering contract's remaining stages have no binding at all. This programme EXTENDS stage coverage and executability. It replaces no stage, weakens no gate and claims no lifecycle authority.

An autonomous engine already exists with mandate coverage, observation, decision and convergence registers. What it lacks is a universal, graph-driven lifecycle to execute for an arbitrary goal. Ω-E04 supplies that substrate; Ω-E05 binds ACEE to it. No autonomous authority is created here.

findings.detail: The ten declared properties are evaluated per discovered stage against located metadata, and every stage currently exhibits every property. The bound is held at zero rather than removed, so the dimension is a RATCHET: if a future stage is admitted that does not exhibit a declared property, or a located instrument stops declaring what a property is measured from, the count rises above the bound and the gate closes. A dimension that only passed because nothing measured it would be the defect this programme exists to prevent.
findings.title: Property conformance is measured per stage and held at full coverage by a zero bound
findings.why_not_repaired: Nothing is presently divergent. The finding is retained because the bound must name a disposing finding to be admissible, and because the ratchet is the reason the bound is zero rather than absent.

findings.detail: Eleven obligations are evaluated against forty-five discovered stages. Applicability is determined first, so the inapplicable cases are reported rather than counted: registration is not applicable where the Universal Registry does not admit the zone the owner lives in — operational memory is deliberately barred from consuming a permanent corpus identity, so its absence from the registry is the exclusion authority working correctly — and replay and fixed-point proof are not applicable to a stage the repository declares constitutionally but does not execute. After applicability, exactly four obligations remain genuinely unbound. THREE belong to gap discovery: its owner lies in a zone that constitutional checks do cover, and the repository does execute it as a pipeline member, but no declared gate certifies, validates or verifies that artifact — so the obligation is in scope and unmet. ONE belongs to certification: it is a pipeline member, so replay is in scope, but the pipeline declares that stage non-reentrant as deliberate defence in depth against a recursion that would stop the repository converging. The bound equals the measured total exactly, so it carries no slack and any regression closes the gate.
findings.title: Four applicable obligations are unbound, each traced to a named cause in Repository Truth
findings.why_not_repaired: An obligation is bound by the located instrument that owns the stage, not by the measurement that reads it. Declaring a gate for gap discovery, or flipping the reentrancy of the certification stage, would amend another owner's record to improve this programme's own report — and in the second case would re-arm the exact recursion the pipeline documents itself as defending against. Each unbound obligation is reported against its stage and its owner in the obligation matrix, so the referral is specific rather than aggregate.

findings.detail: The assimilation register records identifiers UCL-001 through UCL-015 as NOT-UCOS, IDEA, HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE-ONLY, NO_CURRENT_FORM, dispositioned REJECT and RETAIN-AS-HISTORY. Those are concept identifiers in the assimilation concept space. This programme's home is UCL-000001 in the programme-home space and consumes no corpus identity at all, so the two do not collide; the coincidence is recorded here so a future reader does not mistake this programme for the rejected concepts or vice versa.
findings.title: The token UCL is recorded historically against rejected non-UCOS concepts
findings.why_not_repaired: Nothing is defective. Recorded history is never rewritten, and disambiguation is the appropriate remedy rather than a rename that would erase the historical record's usefulness.

findings.detail: A relationship's constitutional identity derives from the semantic identities of its participants. Where a target is a located artifact that the Universal Registry does not admit — overwhelmingly operational memory, which is deliberately barred from consuming a permanent corpus identity — the target has no registered constitutional identity to derive from. Those relationships are counted and reported. Their handles remain distinct, so no relationship is lost or conflated in the graph. The bound is a RATCHET held at exactly the measured value, so it is re-tightened whenever governed records are lawfully admitted. It moved from 92 to 98 when Ω-E05 declared PROGRAM-000021 in the aggregate certifier: that programme delegates to six located owners, every one of which is operational memory the registry deliberately does not admit, so each delegation is exactly this disclosed condition and not a new one. The delta was measured against the committed reading — six added, none removed — rather than assumed, and no other relationship moved.
findings.title: Some relationship targets carry no registered constitutional identity
findings.why_not_repaired: The remedy would be to substitute the target's PATH into the identity, and a path is a location that the invariants expressly permit to evolve — using it would convert a location change into an identity change, which is the defect this invariant exists to prevent. Registering operational memory to obtain an identity would instead violate the exclusion authority. The condition is therefore reported and referred to the registry owner.

obligation_rules.note: A stage whose canonical owner does not resolve rests on nothing. Applicable to every stage without exception.
The authority must be both stated and locatable. Applicable to every stage.
The stage exists because declared constitutional metadata says so — not because implementation source was parsed.
Satisfied by a resolving executable in the fixed-point pipeline or the check register, or by located implementation evidence. Evidence corroborates here; it originates nothing.
Absence of evidence is never evidence.

Applicable when the repository already places the stage's owner inside a zone some constitutional check owns. A stage whose owner no check governs is not yet in validation scope, and saying otherwise would invent a gate.
Applicable on the same condition as validation. At least one reachable check must be fail-closed; an advisory-only stage is not verified.
Applicable when the stage's owner lies in a governed zone. The stage must then be a member of a declared constitutional gate.

Applicable only where the Universal Registry already admits the zone the owner lives in. Operational memory is deliberately barred from consuming a permanent corpus identity, so its absence from the registry is the exclusion authority working — not an unbound obligation. Where the registry DOES cover the zone but not the artifact, the obligation is genuinely unbound and closes the gate.

Applicable when the repository executes the stage as a pipeline member. A stage in the pipeline that is NOT reentrant is genuinely unbound; a stage the repository does not execute has nothing to replay.

Applicable when the stage has a resolving executable at all — an executable thing must converge. An executable stage absent from the convergence pipeline is genuinely unbound; a purely declarative stage has no execution to converge, so the obligation does not arise. The condition tests executability and the rule tests pipeline membership, so the two are not the same question.

programme.$forbidden_write_comment: Every claimant this programme reads. A claimant it could write is a claimant it could silently reconcile, so --check-write-scope fails closed if its own home falls inside one of these and --check-declaration fails closed if a cited owner is left unprotected.
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates no lifecycle, opens no registry, mints no identifier, declares no namespace, admits no capability and certifies nothing. UCIC-001 owns the single deterministic lifecycle every capability follows; CEP-009 ADDENDUM B owns constitutional admission; ENG-001 D30 and UMB-003 §3 own the artifact lifecycle; UEI-000001 §17 owns the evolution lifecycle; 02-EXECUTION-LIFECYCLE.md owns the execution lifecycle. This programme DISCOVERS the constitutional stage graph those instruments already declare, normalizes it into Canonical Knowledge Objects, unifies it without merging its authorities, measures whether each stage is executable, and executes the discovered graph. Where this measurement and a located instrument differ, the located instrument governs.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** This programme holds no constitutional authority. It is not a second lifecycle, not a second registry, not a second dictionary, not a second identifier scheme and not a competing methodology. It creates no stage: every stage it reports is bound to a canonical owner the repository already legislated. It enumerates nothing: stages, capabilities, owners, authorities, obligations, dependencies, admission paths and graph types are discovered from Canonical Constitutional Metadata through providers and adapters. Ω-E04 implements the substrate; Ω-E05 (ACEE) executes it autonomously.

Knowledge Once — canonical knowledge is homed exactly once and discovered, never redefined.
CMG Art LXXVI–LXXVII — every concern has exactly one canonical owner; the map concern→owner is injective.
UCIC-001 — the capability set is discovered from the repository, never enumerated by the executor.
Dependencies are derived and acyclic; a cycle is a defect, never a sequencing preference.
Every constraint is a declared gate; an undeclared constraint binds nothing.
A gap is measured against Repository Truth; absence of evidence is never evidence of absence of a gap.
CMG Art LXXVII.2(a)/LXXVII.4 — where a canonical owner resolves, CREATE is refused and EXTEND is the only lawful disposition.
Observation precedes inference; what is not observed may not be asserted.
Every architectural faculty resolves to a located owner, a home and a registered analysis.
A declared property that nothing measures is reported DECLARED-NOT-MEASURABLE, never passed silently.
Evidence is emitted to a journal before a claim rests on it; fail-closed on missing evidence.

Verification re-derives the claim from the repository; a command exiting zero is not verification.
Learning appends; it never rewrites what was previously recorded.
Reasoning is traceable to observed evidence and declared law, never to preference.
A change is simulated against the repository before it is committed to the repository.
A measured divergence is referred to its owner under CEP-002 Art 23.2, never adjudicated by the measurer.
Correction is a forward append with a recorded cause; the past is never rewritten.

UCIC-001 — the single deterministic lifecycle every capability follows; no capability may bypass it or skip a gate.
A capability is tested against its declared contract before it is certified against it.
Governance is exercised by the declared owner through a declared gate; no parallel authority may arise.
Certification closes scope, never evolution; a certificate rests only on gates that ran.
Integration binds a capability into the located canonical structure; it never forks a parallel structure.
REG-AUTO-001 — registration is automatic and derived; an unregistered artifact is not an artifact.
AIF Part III A/G-AUTH — there is exactly ONE identity authority; allocation is append-only and never reissued.
ENG-001 D11 — a namespace minted without a declared classification rule is a namespace no authority governs.
UMB-005 — the registry is DERIVED truth, regenerated and never hand-authored.
Bookkeeping is append-only: every prior content hash is preserved and no snapshot is ever edited.
UCI-001 Part XVI.5 — lineage and evolution are DERIVED projections over recorded history; no new store is created.
Repository Truth is regenerated by its owner alone; a reader that repaired it would commit the defect it reports.
Committed registers must be the product of their declaration; drift means the committed bytes evidence nothing.
RFP-2/RFP-3 — no commit self-reference and no working-tree self-observation, so the repository converges.
Knowledge is extracted into the located knowledge home, not restated in the artifact that produced it.
Every decision is registered with its evidence; an unregistered decision governs nothing.
AUTH-INF-001 CR-INF-001 — Ω∞ non-terminality: certification closes scope, never evolution.

AUTH-INF-001 CR-INF-007/009 — engineering capability expands append-only, with no architectural ceiling.
Autonomy is bound to the same gates as manual execution; an autonomous actor gains no exemption.
